what: October 2026 MVS predictions (results/r2x2, one sample per task) regraded. old_f1_stored: the F1 in the October scorecard. old_f1: the October path grader (mvs.grade_mvs_paths) run today on the same prediction and today's reference. new_f1, success, target_f1: the drawn-state grader. Strict scoring: a scene Mol* rejected, or a reply that is not a scene, scores 0 on every measure; valid_only averages over the scenes Mol* accepted. No task has a target field yet, so the target is everything the reference draws. highlight_target_f1 is the target score with the target set by rule to the atoms of the reference's components that are not a whole-structure selector ('polymer', 'all', ...): the residues or ligand the request is about, without the context cartoon (tasks with no such component are left out; n_with_highlight_target counts the rest). success_if_any_focus_counts: task success if a camera focus the request did not ask for is counted as wrong (drawn.GRADE_UNREQUESTED_FOCUS = True; the default is not to count it).
references: tasks/ as of this commit (the clinical and other references still draw context the prompts do not ask for; decision 17 replaces them)
